# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Modern UWP and image testing**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds modern .NET UWP controls and an experimental image-comparison package. This unreleased line also corrects runtime-effect uniform initialization, Windows image-decoding crashes and GPU texture-edge sampling. Linux x86 native assets are no longer included.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications deployed on 32-bit x86 Linux must move to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison** — The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and produces difference images. Opt in to experimental diagnostic SKIA4001; returned difference images are caller-owned. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Platform

- **Modern .NET UWP controls** — SkiaSharp.Views.UWP adds CPU SKXamlCanvas and ANGLE-backed SKSwapChainPanel controls targeting net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0, with a declared Windows minimum of 10.0.17763.0. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies UWP integration for x86, x64 and ARM64. This does not restore legacy uap10.0 support; drawing surfaces remain control-managed. — ❤️ [@FoggyFinder](https://github.com/FoggyFinder) ([#4540](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4540))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 image-decoding recovery** — Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives, including malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and lazy non-JPEG images in PDF output. Other architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Trim-safe MAUI window binding** — SKGLView uses a statically expressed Window binding instead of a runtime string path, removing the associated trimming warning without changing the binding's behavior. — ❤️ [@bhall-ctre](https://github.com/bhall-ctre) ([#5320](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5320))
- **Safer Ganesh texture-edge sampling** — Filtered texture-subset sampling clamps slightly inward to avoid undefined exterior texels, and unsafe edge-copy shortcuts are disabled. Texture-edge pixels may change; this affects Ganesh, not CPU or Graphite rendering. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection** — The intended blur configuration now reaches Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths rather than the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Zeroed runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start at zero, and Reset clears the existing buffer in place instead of replacing it with uninitialized storage. Repeated resets no longer allocate a native buffer and wrapper. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))

## Engine

- **Skia m159 servicing fixes** — Updates the bundled native engine with upstream fixes within milestone 159, without changing managed bindings or advancing the Skia milestone. ([#5841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5841))
